notes: Copyright (c) 2026 Cyberalien. Runtime, transports and the scaffolded interface files in app/. Full text in LICENCES/CyToolsCore-MIT.txt and app/LICENSE-CyToolsCore.txt; installed from the public repository at the commit pinned in app/requirements.txt.

name: CyUI (Python port, vendored as app/cyui.py)
notes: Copyright (c) 2026 Cyberalien. Themes, fonts and widgets of the window; an unchanged copy of python/cyui.py from the author's CyImgui_Interface project (not published). Full text in LICENCES/CyUI-MIT.txt. The Windows fonts it uses are read from the system and not shipped.

name: llama.cpp (b11114, Windows x64 CPU and CUDA 12.4 builds)
notes: Downloaded from the pinned GitHub release into runtime/engines. The CUDA build also carries NVIDIA CUDA runtime libraries, redistributed under the NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit end user licence agreement.

name: NVIDIA CUDA runtime libraries (cudart 12.4)
notes: Shipped inside the llama.cpp CUDA release asset. Redistribution terms are NVIDIA's, not this Tool's.

name: cyai_connectors (vendored from CyAI Connector Lab)
notes: A copy of the portable connector library used for the Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity and OpenCode adapters. Its source project declares no licence.

name: Agent command lines (codex, claude, agy, opencode)
notes: Not redistributed with this Tool. It starts the programs already installed on the machine, under the account already signed in there, and their own terms of use apply.

name: Qwen3 4B, Qwen3 8B, Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct (GGUF)
notes: Downloaded on request into data/models. Read the licence on each model page.

name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct (GGUF)
notes: Not an open-source licence. It carries acceptable use and redistribution conditions you must read before using the model.

name: LoRA-Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-abliterated (GGUF LoRA)
notes: The repository declares no licence, so its terms are unknown. It is included because it is a published GGUF adapter that makes a real LoRA test possible.

name: fermion_container.py (vendored, Phonon-2 reader)
notes: Copyright 2026 Fermion Research. Unchanged copy in app/aichat/vendor; full licence text in LICENCES/Apache-2.0.txt.

name: Speech environments (PyTorch, transformers, coqui-tts, f5-tts)
notes: Installed on request into runtime/engines/stt and runtime/engines/tts; not distributed with the Tool. The CUDA build of PyTorch brings NVIDIA libraries under the CUDA Toolkit EULA.

name: Phonon-2 (speech to text)
notes: Derived from NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (CC-BY-4.0) by Fermion Research.

name: XTTS-v2 (text to speech)
notes: Non-commercial use only, of the model and of its output.

name: F5-TTS v1 Base and F5-TTS French (text to speech)
notes: Non-commercial use only. The French model is by RASPIAUDIO: https://huggingface.co/RASPIAUDIO/F5-French-MixedSpeakers-reduced
